about: Listing and README artwork. `generated` are the native originals, each with an empty panel for a screenshot; `exports` are written by scripts/marketing_images.py, which pastes a real screenshot of the built page into the panel and scales to the listing sizes.

generated.tool: Codex CLI built-in image generation (image_gen), image edit
generated.exact_prompt:
EDIT the attached image (an approved software marketing banner). Generate exactly one image with the same aspect ratio as the attached image, 

Edit instructions:
1. Replace the small grey scope line under the headline with exactly this text, same font, size, colour and position: "Status, files, camera and print for Anycubic printers." (EXACT, verbatim, no extra characters). Ensure it appears once, perfectly legible and correctly spelled.
2. Replace the 3D printer and the filament box with a photorealistic generic Anycubic Kobra-family style desktop FDM printer, same position and similar size: white and light-grey open-frame bed-slinger with a single upright gantry, a moving build plate carrying the same multicolour printed ship, a small tilted touchscreen on the base, a top spool holder with spools, next to a black multi-spool filament dryer box with a smoked lid and four coloured spools. The machines carry no visible text, no model names, no badges, no letter marks and no logos at all: clean plain panels.
Keep unchanged: the app tile and the product name, every other line of copy exactly as it is now, the background, theme, lighting, the six colour tiles bottom-left, the signature, and the large rounded EMPTY panel on the right at exactly the same size and position with its thin border and perfectly uniform flat interior colour (no UI, no text, no objects inside, nothing overlapping it). No extra words, no watermark, no other brand logos, no people.
generated.earlier_prompt: Use case: compositing. Image 1 is the edit target, an approved Kobra Control main banner in en. Image 2 is the user's real printer photograph. Replace generic printer/hardware/spool photographic props in image 1 with the faithful printer from image 2 (Anycubic Kobra X: tall white gantry, top colored filament spools and tubes, separate black ACE feeder on left, multicolor boat on bed, white base and tilted controller). Preserve actual architecture, parts, proportions and original product colors. Remove source white backdrop; integrate naturally into existing realistic workshop lighting and contact shadows. Printer prominent and complete in left photographic area, BELOW ALL TEXT with generous gap, no cropped top or base; clear generic props to make room. Preserve EXACT aspect ratio, ALL copy verbatim in existing language, typography, app icon, accent colors, light/dark theme, footer chips and 'by bloodf'. Keep right EMPTY SQUARE same size and position; blank uniform interior, no UI/text/photo/product overlap. No extra wording or pack name. Change only photographic foreground. Professional product advertising.
